freshImport.scope: Same-account native import on a Professional plan; one nondefault Present journey.

usage.setup: Import the .fig into your own Figma Drafts, record your new file URL and actual local identities, then verify local components, variables, images, destinations and the prototype journey.
usage.baselineContext: Completed Store/Review frames are comparison material. Exclude them and their answer-key content from the initial Claude Design generation context.
usage.separateDownloads: This native companion is separate from the Velori React source ZIP and the publishing-toolkit ZIP.
usage.planRequirement: The variable-driven native journey requires a paid Figma Design or eligible Education plan and can edit access to the working file. Starter can import the .fig but does not provide variables, expressions or conditional logic in prototypes.

limitations: Arimo/Lora in Figma differs from Arial/Georgia in React.
Authored native frames are 1024×768; one imported journey does not prove all 72 native configurations, narrow layout, reload/storage, real image failure, Retry or browser keyboard/focus parity.
Native Present had screen-reader support disabled.
The native Figma companion contains no separately packaged Anthropic support.js runtime; captured Claude Design runtime and private owner/account/upload receipts remain excluded.
Each reader must record and verify their own imported copy; this manifest does not certify a future import.
The imported-content disclosure read covers accessible fields. Private/shared plugin metadata and opaque binary fields are not certified sanitized.
